verdict.rationale: Airweave documents an official CLI on its own docs site (docs.airweave.ai/cli), with terminal-based collection search as its stated primary use case. That satisfies the story of using an official CLI, and the probe confirms the CLI page exists. missing for 10: documented installation and authentication steps, coverage of commands beyond search (e.g. managing collections, source connections or syncs), any independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The primary use case — search any collection from your terminal
